Illustrate the KEGG map of the MAPK signaling pathway in Saccharomyces cerevisiae as depicted by Kanehisa and Goto (2000)

Illustrate the KEGG map of the MAPK signaling pathway in Saccharomyces cerevisiae as depicted by Kanehisa and Goto (2000). The map highlights the positions and targets of key phosphatases (ptc1, ptp2, ptp3, msg5, mih1, sdp1) within the mapk cascades, illustrating their roles in regulating hog1, fus3, and slt2 mapks and maintaining signaling fidelity
Download JPG
View figure at PMC Read paper at PMC

Publication

Frontiers in fungal phosphatases: molecular diversity, regulatory mechanisms, analytical methodologies, ecological significance, and prospects for sustainable utilization (2026) Samiyah Saeed Al-Zahrani, et al. Front Bioeng Biotechnol. 2026 Feb 20;14(NA). Figure: F5.
